description: Source-backed import, FOFRM composition, polygonal sprite meshing, baked-container, client sprite, atlas, cache, and validation contract for FOnline images.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned Engine revision. Projects own asset catalogs, source licensing, visual style, compression policy, resource-pack precedence, animation substitutions, movement tuning, and visible acceptance.
included: the twelve built-in ImageBaker source extensions and their current import behavior
FOFRM fields, aliases, direction sections, nested references, filename options, flattening, offsets, and timing
the versioned private RGBA/mesh frame container, per-pack SpriteInfo index, and output-renaming behavior
default client sprite-factory coverage, SpriteSheet playback, polygon or quad atlas drawing, hit masks, caches, and diagnostics
focused source-anchor, generator, native-test, project-bake, and visible-validation boundaries
excluded: project image catalogs, resource-pack precedence, asset licenses, art direction, quality targets, and acceptance baselines
authoritative movement and the detailed walk/run projection algorithm documented by SpriteRootMotion.md
particle authoring, model textures, shader effects, GUI layout, fonts, video, and audio formats
a public compatibility promise for the private baked byte stream or unsupported third-party image formats

formats.name: FOFRM descriptor
formats.requirement: FOFRM composes relative image references into one static image, animation, or complete direction sheet and is the preferred authored wrapper for multi-frame or option-bearing sources.
formats.rationale: It is the only built-in text descriptor that can combine sources, add frame deltas, and produce a runtime-loadable .fofrm path.

formats.name: Fallout FRM
formats.requirement: FRM imports big-endian frame timing, offsets, deltas, one or complete direction tables, optional same-basename .pal data, and animated default-palette indices.
formats.rationale: The importer preserves legacy frame geometry while normalizing pixels into the Engine RGBA container.

formats.name: Split directional FRx set
formats.requirement: A .fr0 entry discovers its numbered directional siblings, rejects a gap after direction loading begins, and renames baked output to lowercase .fofrm for critter paths or .frm otherwise.
formats.rationale: The split legacy representation must become one runtime direction sheet with a deterministic output path.

formats.name: RIX image
formats.requirement: RIX imports one opaque indexed image using its embedded palette and emits one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: The format has no authored animation or direction metadata.

formats.name: Fallout Tactics ART
formats.requirement: ART imports raw or RLE frames, palettes, offsets, frame rate, static or eight-rotation data, and the palette/alpha/mirror/frame filename options.
formats.rationale: ART direction numbering and frame metadata require format-specific remapping before runtime use.

formats.name: Fallout Tactics SPR
formats.availability: baker only by default; wrap through FOFRM for the stock runtime
formats.requirement: SPR imports named sequences, layered parts, direction remapping, color offsets, repeated-frame sharing, and fixed 10 fps, but the stock DefaultSpriteFactory does not register the .spr extension.
formats.rationale: Directly baked .spr output cannot be loaded by the default client; a .fofrm wrapper gives the output a registered extension without changing imported pixels.

formats.name: ZAR image
formats.requirement: ZAR imports one palette-backed raw or RLE image with alpha into one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: ZAR is a single-image legacy container used directly and inside TIL.

formats.name: TIL animation
formats.requirement: TIL imports its nested ZAR frames as a 10 fps single-direction sequence.
formats.rationale: The loader supplies timing because the legacy container exposes a frame list rather than an Engine animation descriptor.

formats.name: MOS or MOSC tiled image
formats.requirement: MOS imports one tiled palette image; MOSC is decompressed first, and palette color 0x00FF00 is made transparent.
formats.rationale: Packed and unpacked files share one extension and normalize to one RGBA frame.

formats.name: BAM or BAMC animation
formats.requirement: BAM imports one selected cycle or one selected frame, supports packed BAMC input and RLE, derives frame deltas, and treats palette blue 255 as transparent.
formats.rationale: Cycle/frame lookup and palette transparency are part of the legacy format rather than generic sprite behavior.

formats.name: PNG image
formats.requirement: PNG is decoded through libpng, strips 16-bit channels to 8-bit, expands palette/low-bit grayscale/tRNS data, and fills missing alpha with 255 before emitting one RGBA frame.
formats.rationale: PNG is the recommended lossless authored source for ordinary project images and transparent sprites.

formats.name: TGA TrueColor image
formats.requirement: TGA supports only raw type 2 or RLE type 10 TrueColor input at 24 or 32 bpp, converts BGR(A) to RGBA, and flips rows bottom-to-top.
formats.rationale: Indexed, grayscale, other bit depths, image IDs, and alternate-origin assumptions are outside the implemented production subset.

descriptor_fields.name: fps / Fps
descriptor_fields.requirement: FOFRM reads lowercase fps first and then legacy Fps; zero creates a non-playing sheet, while production animation values must also keep whole duration per frame above zero.
descriptor_fields.rationale: The authored count and fps determine whole-sheet AnimTicks, while runtime playback divides that duration by flattened frame count.

descriptor_fields.name: count / Count
descriptor_fields.requirement: Count is the number of descriptor references per direction, defaults to one, and must be positive; it is not necessarily the final flattened frame count.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Each referenced source can itself contain multiple frames.

descriptor_fields.name: offs_x / offs_y and OffsetX / OffsetY
descriptor_fields.default: 0 in the root section; inherited from the previous parsed direction when omitted
descriptor_fields.requirement: Sequence offsets are signed and may be authored in the root or each direction section; explicitly set both values in every direction section because omitted values carry forward.
descriptor_fields.rationale: The parser reuses the current ox/oy variables instead of resetting them for each direction.

descriptor_fields.name: effect / Effect
descriptor_fields.requirement: The parser accepts effect/Effect into FrameCollection.EffectName for compatibility, but ImageBaker does not serialize or apply it and the stock runtime never selects an effect from this field.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Authors must not treat a parsed-but-unused field as a rendering contract.

descriptor_fields.name: [dir_N] / [Dir_N]
descriptor_fields.requirement: A descriptor is either single-direction or supplies every Engine map direction; partial direction sets and later gaps fail.
descriptor_fields.rationale: SpriteSheet accepts exactly one direction or GameSettings::MAP_DIR_COUNT directions.

anchors: throw ImageBakerException("FOFRM file invalid apps", fname);

descriptor_fields.name: frm / Frm and frm_N / Frm_N
descriptor_fields.requirement: Every authored descriptor slot resolves one relative image path; only slot zero also accepts the unnumbered frm/Frm alias.
descriptor_fields.rationale: References are joined with the descriptor directory and then dispatched by the referenced extension.

anchors: auto sub_collection = LoadAny(strex("{}/{}", frm_dir, frm_name), files);

descriptor_fields.name: next_x_N / next_y_N and NextX_N / NextY_N
descriptor_fields.requirement: Descriptor frame deltas are added to every flattened child frame's imported NextX/NextY values.
descriptor_fields.rationale: This preserves source-format displacement while allowing authored composition corrections.

descriptor_fields.name: Nested sequence flattening
descriptor_fields.requirement: FOFRM appends the Main sequence of every referenced child; child direction sheets and child sequence offsets are not composed, and all authored parent directions must flatten to the same final frame count.
descriptor_fields.rationale: The merge loop copies child Main frames only and validates each later direction against collection.SequenceSize.

descriptor_fields.name: FOFRM whole-sequence timing
descriptor_fields.requirement: FOFRM computes whole-sequence duration from authored descriptor count, not from the flattened child-frame count; fps zero yields zero ticks.
descriptor_fields.rationale: Nested animated references can therefore change effective frame cadence unless the author accounts for flattening.

filename_options.name: ART palette, alpha, mirror, and frame selection
filename_options.requirement: Digits select the last requested available palette, T derives alpha from maximum RGB while index zero remains transparent, H/V mirror, and F selects an inclusive ascending or descending clamped frame/range; letters are case-insensitive and unknown characters are ignored.
filename_options.rationale: Options are parsed from the source reference without changing the physical source filename.

filename_options.name: SPR part color offsets and sequence
filename_options.requirement: Zero or more bracket entries set clamped RGB offsets for part 0 other, 1 skin, 2 hair, or 3 armor; an out-of-range part applies the RGB values to all parts, and text after the last bracket selects a sequence case-insensitively (empty selects the first).
filename_options.rationale: The importer composes palette layers and animation selection before writing runtime RGBA frames.

filename_options.name: BAM cycle and frame selection
filename_options.requirement: The integer before '-' selects a cycle and an optional non-negative integer after '-' selects one frame; out-of-range cycle/frame values fall back to zero, while no frame selector imports the whole cycle.
filename_options.rationale: The source can expose many cycles while one resource path needs deterministic output.

baking_rules.name: Scan and targeted modes
baking_rules.requirement: An empty target scans every registered extension; a targeted missing, unsupported, or BakeChecker-skipped path returns without output.
baking_rules.rationale: Incremental project builds and one-file rebakes share one baker without treating a skipped target as failure.

baking_rules.name: Case-insensitive extension dispatch
baking_rules.requirement: Source and runtime extension lookup uses get_file_extension(), which returns the extension without its dot and lowercases it.
baking_rules.rationale: Mixed-case extensions resolve to the same registered loader, though projects should still use canonical lowercase paths.

anchors: get_file_extension() noexcept -> strex&; // Extension without dot and lowered

baking_rules.name: Dollar option dispatch
baking_rules.requirement: LoadAny strips text after '$' from the physical filename, passes that suffix to the selected loader, and resolves the source inside the same FileCollection.
baking_rules.rationale: One source file can produce selected or transformed variants through FOFRM references without duplicate binaries.

baking_rules.name: Output path and NewName
baking_rules.requirement: The baked resource normally keeps its source path; loaders may set NewName, which replaces that output path for legacy normalization.
baking_rules.rationale: FRM/FRx critter normalization and split-direction aggregation require deterministic renamed resources.

baking_rules.name: Private container header
baking_rules.requirement: The private baked stream starts with SpriteResource magic 43 and version 2, then uint16 frame count, uint16 whole animation ticks, and uint8 direction count, and ends with magic 43.
baking_rules.rationale: The shared SpriteResource decoder validates the versioned framing before any client or tool consumes pixels or mesh data.

baking_rules.name: Direction records
baking_rules.requirement: Each of one or GameSettings::MAP_DIR_COUNT directions stores exactly the common frame count; the resolved logical root offset is serialized on every concrete frame after mesh padding and cropping.
baking_rules.rationale: Per-frame offsets preserve screen placement when polygon geometry changes the serialized canvas independently for each direction and animation frame.

baking_rules.name: Concrete and shared frame records
baking_rules.requirement: Each frame starts with a shared flag; a concrete record stores signed int16 draw offset, uint16 cropped dimensions, signed int16 NextX/NextY, exact RGBA8 pixels, a mesh kind, and mesh vertices and indices plus logical source size and origin when the kind is Mesh. A shared record stores one earlier-frame index.
baking_rules.rationale: The record preserves logical placement and lighting coordinates while avoiding transparent texture rows and submitting indexed silhouettes; repeated frames still reuse the original payload.

baking_rules.name: Per-pack SpriteInfo index
baking_rules.requirement: Image baking maintains SpriteInfo/<PackName>.foinfo version 1 with duration, direction, frame bounds, offsets, and shared-frame metadata for every current image source in that resource pack.
baking_rules.rationale: Common EngineMetadata can answer 2D animation queries on server and client without decoding RGBA payloads; losing or introducing the aggregate index requires a full rebake.

anchors: Sprite info index is incomplete; perform a full resource rebake

baking_rules.name: Optional polygonal sprite mesh
baking_rules.requirement: Resolve and validate the complete SpriteMesh setting group for every image bake, including when SpriteMesh.Enabled is false: AlphaThreshold is 0..254, MaxTriangles is positive, and AreaSavingsWeight is finite and non-negative. When enabled, build deterministic alpha-thresholded candidates within that triangle budget, score saved original-frame area against submitted triangles, retain only validated coverage, crop selected mesh canvases to exact geometry bounds, and preserve the logical root through the serialized frame offset.
baking_rules.rationale: The opt-in path reduces transparent overdraw and texture area without clipping visible pixels or changing gameplay placement; unsafe or unprofitable candidates remain quads and empty masks remain explicit empty geometry.

baking_rules.name: Per-file work and aggregate failure
baking_rules.requirement: Selected files bake asynchronously; each exception is logged, and any nonzero error count ends the Image baker with ImageBakerException.
baking_rules.rationale: A full scan reports all independently failing image resources in one run without silently succeeding.

anchors: throw ImageBakerException("Errors during images baking", errors)

runtime_rules.name: Default factory extension boundary
runtime_rules.requirement: DefaultSpriteFactory registers every built-in ImageBaker extension except spr; direct .spr paths need a custom factory or, normally, an authored .fofrm wrapper.
runtime_rules.rationale: Bake support and stock runtime path support are separate extension registries.

runtime_rules.name: Baked-container decoding
runtime_rules.requirement: The stock runtime reads only the baked container through ReadSpriteResource, validates magic, version, frame and direction counts, complete frame/mesh records, footer, and trailing data, then constructs either AtlasSprite or SpriteSheet.
runtime_rules.rationale: Source decoders are baker-only and are not deployed as runtime image parsers.

runtime_rules.name: Single-frame behavior
runtime_rules.requirement: A one-frame one-direction resource becomes AtlasSprite and applies the resolved concrete-frame draw offset; serialized NextX/NextY remains metadata because there is no SpriteSheet frame-displacement surface.
runtime_rules.rationale: NextX/NextY matter only when a sheet consumer selects and interprets animation frames.

runtime_rules.name: Direction and playback state
runtime_rules.requirement: SpriteSheet accepts one or the full map direction count, supports direction selection, random prewarm, normalized time, loop/reverse playback, and treats one frame or zero whole ticks as non-playing.
runtime_rules.rationale: Animation state is client presentation state and each direction owns a parallel frame sheet.

runtime_rules.name: Per-frame sprite offsets
runtime_rules.requirement: Concrete and shared SpriteSheet frames retain imported NextX/NextY in _sprOffset; ordinary drawing uses the selected AtlasSprite offset, while locomotion projection consumes the separate frame-offset array.
runtime_rules.rationale: Visual root-motion displacement must remain separate from sequence placement and authoritative world movement.

runtime_rules.name: Atlas upload, polygon draw, border, and hit mask
runtime_rules.requirement: Positive-size RGBA frames are placed in the requested AtlasType, uploaded with duplicated one-pixel filtering edges, and converted to a SpriteHitValue hit mask. Ordinary full-image draws submit the baked indexed silhouette when present; crops, tiled and padded draws, fonts, blits, model sprites, and particles retain rectangular paths.
runtime_rules.rationale: Mesh geometry changes fill and submission cost without changing atlas pixels, picking, logical scaling, or specialized rectangular rendering contracts.

runtime_rules.name: Copyable sprite cache identity
runtime_rules.requirement: Copyable sprites are cached by hashed path plus AtlasType and each load returns MakeCopy, so the same source path may have separate atlas-backed cache entries.
runtime_rules.rationale: Independent animation state must not mutate the cached prototype, and different atlas classes cannot share placement blindly.

runtime_rules.name: Missing-path memoization
runtime_rules.requirement: Missing paths, absent extensions, unknown factories, and factory load failures are memoized by path in _nonFoundSprites; CleanupSpriteCache does not clear that set.
runtime_rules.rationale: Adding a previously missing resource during a live session normally requires recreating the manager or restarting the client before retrying the same path.

validation_rules.name: Positive FOFRM count
validation_rules.requirement: Reject a descriptor whose count/Count is zero or negative.
validation_rules.rationale: A descriptor must resolve at least one source reference before a runtime frame table can exist.

validation_rules.name: Complete equal-size directions
validation_rules.requirement: Reject partial direction sets and any later direction whose flattened frame count differs from direction zero.
validation_rules.rationale: Every direction sheet shares one frame-count and timing header.

anchors: throw ImageBakerException("FOFRM file invalid data", fname)

validation_rules.name: No nested shared frame records
validation_rules.requirement: Reject a FOFRM reference whose child Main frame is already a shared record.
validation_rules.rationale: The flattening implementation copies concrete child pixels and does not rebase child shared indices.

validation_rules.name: Exact RGBA payload size
validation_rules.requirement: Reject every concrete frame whose byte payload is not exactly width times height times four.
validation_rules.rationale: The client reads a fixed RGBA8 byte count without a separate payload-length field.

anchors: Animation frame RGBA payload size does not match frame dimensions

validation_rules.name: Supported TGA subset
validation_rules.requirement: Use no image ID, bottom-left orientation, TrueColor type 2 or 10, and 24 or 32 bpp; indexed/grayscale/other inputs are rejected or outside the implemented orientation assumptions.
validation_rules.rationale: The loader consumes the fixed header directly, then always flips rows and does not branch on descriptor origin.

validation_rules.name: Malformed decoder inputs
validation_rules.requirement: Keep focused failure coverage for corrupt PNG, TGA, FRM/FRx/RIX/ART/ZAR/TIL/MOS/BAM, SPR, and nested FOFRM inputs.
validation_rules.rationale: Legacy binary parsers must fail deterministically instead of emitting truncated runtime containers.

validation_rules.name: Runtime container guards
validation_rules.requirement: Reject invalid header/footer magic, zero frames, zero directions, unsupported direction counts, invalid single-frame shared records, and invalid shared-frame indices.
validation_rules.rationale: Corrupt baked bytes must not reach atlas allocation or animation updates.

anchors: Sprite resource header magic is invalid
Sprite frame reference points outside previously decoded frames
Sprite file direction count is unsupported
Single-frame sprite resource cannot contain a shared-frame reference

validation_rules.name: Nonzero per-frame duration
validation_rules.requirement: For a playing multi-frame sheet, author timing so whole AnimTicks divided by flattened frame count is at least one millisecond; fps zero intentionally disables playback.
validation_rules.rationale: SpriteSheet::Update divides elapsed time by integer ticks_per_frame, while Play only guards one frame or zero whole ticks.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project visual gate
validation_rules.requirement: After native and documentation checks, rebake the embedding project and inspect changed dimensions, alpha edges, mirrors, directions, cadence, offsets, hit masks, and relevant client profiles in a visible scene.
validation_rules.rationale: Parser and container tests cannot prove art framing, filtering, gait, or project resource-pack selection.
